title: Why players choose us
sub: Four reasons, and every one of them is something you will feel on your first visit.

items.title: Friendly community
items.text: Regular social play and a club that introduces people to each other.

items.title: Quality courts
items.text: Six courts, maintained and resurfaced on schedule.

items.title: Coaching for every level
items.text: Private and group coaching from first swing to competitive play.

items.title: Beginners genuinely welcome
items.text: Rackets to borrow, beginner sessions, and no assumed experience.
